text: Do the 4D SU(3) results hold at three or more couplings, extrapolated, with the Luscher term and zero-temperature string breaking?
description:
OP-10: the strong-force results toward the continuum.

Known: one or two couplings each. Only 3D SU(2) is extrapolated.

Unknown: the continuum limits in 4D, the Luscher term, the potential flattening near 1.2 fm.

Why it matters: planned paper 1 is stronger with continuum limits.

Scope: boxes of $16^4$ and more, days of compute.

Skills: lattice gauge theory, compute.

Where to start: note/experiment/gauge/strong-force.md; code/dynamics/gauge-lattice.ts.

The claims it would move: R-FRC-0001, R-FRC-0004.

Evidence named: strong-force map, what is still open.
